# SafeAgent
# Machine-readable capability description for agent frameworks, MCP directories,
# x402 scanners, and other automated callers. Not marketing copy — read this if
# you are deciding whether to call this API.
# Base URL: https://safeagent-production.up.railway.app

## Capability
Exactly-once execution guard with an optional safety-attestation gate.

Given an idempotency key (request_id) plus an action type, SafeAgent ensures the
side-effecting call it protects executes at most once. Retries, duplicate signals,
webhook redelivery, and concurrent callers all collapse to a single execution;
every call after the first returns the original cached result instead of firing
the action again.

Optionally (per-deployment flag, see "Attestation gate" below), each /claim also
verifies a signed AgentGraph safety attestation for the action type before the
claim is allowed to commit. This is a real safety gate, not a badge: a critical/
high safety finding blocks the commit with an HTTP 403, not just a log line.

## Guarantee — state machine
PENDING -> COMMITTED | SKIP

- New key -> PROCEED. Caller executes the action, then calls /settle.
- Same key while still PENDING -> PENDING. Another caller has this in-flight;
  retry after SAFEAGENT_PENDING_TTL (default 300s).
- Same key after /settle -> SKIP + the original cached result. The action is
  never re-executed.
- With the attestation gate active and require_attestation=true -> DENY
  (HTTP 403, body: {"error":"safety_denied","reason":...,"action":...}) if the
  AgentGraph verdict flags a critical/high finding, or if the attestation
  cannot be reached at all. No COMMITTED write happens on DENY.
- With require_attestation=false (default): an unreachable or missing
  attestation does not block the claim — it SKIPs the safety check and
  records the reason, it never silently passes as "verified."

## Call flow
1. POST /claim  {"request_id": str, "action": str}
   -> {"status": "PROCEED"} | {"status": "SKIP", "existing": {...}} | {"status": "PENDING"}
   x402-gated: $0.001 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). See /.well-known/x402.
2. Execute your action only when status is PROCEED.
3. POST /settle/{request_id}  {"result": {...}}  -> marks COMMITTED. Free, not
   payment-gated.
4. POST /claim/test  {"agent_id": str, "action_type": str, "scope": str}
   -> same PROCEED/SKIP semantics, no payment, 10 calls per IP total, for
   evaluation only. The attestation gate does not apply to this endpoint.
5. GET /audit?agent_id=&action=&status=&from_ts=&to_ts=&limit=&offset=
   -> filterable claim history, newest first. Free.
6. POST /sweep -> resets stale PENDING rows back to claimable. Free.

## Attestation gate (AgentGraph)
- Config: SAFEAGENT_REQUIRE_ATTESTATION env var on the deployment (not a
  per-call parameter you set). Default false.
- Verifies an Ed25519/JWS-signed AgentGraph safety attestation against the
  issuer JWKS, binds it to this specific claim (action_ref + binding_digest,
  JCS/RFC 8785 + SHA-256 — replay against a different charge is rejected),
  and requires admission.verdict == "admit".
- Distinguishes an availability stop (attestation_unreachable) from a safety
  stop (safety_denied on a critical/high finding) — different failure modes,
  different responses.
- Optional freshness check (freshness_ttl_seconds): a stale or expired verdict
  is rejected the same as a missing one.
- Source: safeagent_exec_guard/attestation_gate.py in this repo.

## Discovery documents
- OpenAPI schema: /openapi.json
- MCP manifest: /.well-known/mcp.json (MCP endpoint at /mcp)
- Agent card (A2A-style): /.well-known/agent.json
- x402 resource descriptor: /.well-known/x402
- SafeAgent-specific discovery doc (most complete, includes payloads/pricing
  per endpoint): /.well-known/safeagent.json

## Not part of this API
/audit-service is a human-facing HTML page (a paid duplicate-execution audit
product, $2,500 flat fee). It returns marketing HTML, not JSON. Ignore it for
automated integration — it is not a capability of the exactly-once guard.

## Integration
pip install safeagent-exec-guard
npm install n8n-nodes-safeagent
MCP Registry: io.github.azender1/safeagent

## Compliance
Tamper-evident execution logs. Cited as relevant to EU AI Act Art. 12
(enforcement deadline August 2, 2026) — not a legal compliance guarantee,
an audit-trail primitive.
